heroTitle:
Test your device.
Know every detail.
heroDescription: {count} tools to test your screen, input devices, audio, camera, gamepad and browser. Free, with nothing to install.
unsupported: Not supported by this browser or device.
fullscreenUnavailable: Fullscreen is unavailable; you can still inspect the test area.
how1Text: Find a tool for your device or the behavior you want to investigate.
how2Text: Run a measurement, press keys or inspect patterns on your display.
how3Text: Every tool explains its method and the limits of browser observation.
privacyText: Keyboard events, mouse events and test history are processed locally, without uploading them. No advertising or third-party tracking.
faqLocalQ: Do I need to install an app?
faqLocalA: No. Tools run in your browser without an account. Some APIs require a compatible browser and HTTPS.
faqAccuracyA: Not always. Each tool distinguishes direct observations, estimates, calculations and manual inspection. Read the limitations below the test.
faqSaveA: Only summaries are saved when you enable local saving. Keyboard and mouse logs are not saved automatically.
toolLimitQ: What should I consider when using {name}?
hiddenWarning: The tab became hidden or lost focus. Sampling stopped; retest with the tab visible.
insufficient: Not enough valid samples. Retest and keep interacting continuously.
unstable: Intervals vary substantially or include delayed frames. System load may affect this result.
copyError: Copy failed; select the result and copy it manually.
invalidInput: Enter integer dimensions from 1–100,000 and a positive diagonal up to 1,000 inches.
physicalCaveat: This estimate does not confirm native panel resolution.
manualInspection: Inspect the display yourself; there is no automatic pixel detection.
patternHint: Tap to change · ← → for patterns · Esc to exit
fullscreenError: Cannot enter fullscreen. Allow Fullscreen or use the current test area.
touchHint: Touch or use a pen inside this area
touchOnly: Only touch and pen inputs count; mouse input is not a touch test.
captureHint: Click to activate. Tab or Esc exits. System shortcuts may not reach this area.
captureActive: Capturing keys · Tab or Esc exits
buttonTestHint: Press, release or move your mouse inside this area
pollingHint: Move the mouse continuously inside the area while sampling
pollingWarning: Browser event frequency does not confirm USB Polling Rate.
saveResults: Allow up to 30 local test summaries
storageError: Local storage is unavailable. You can still use the tools.
privacyDetails: Theme, language and preferences are stored on this device. Summaries are saved only when enabled and explicitly saved; they exclude keyboard and mouse logs. Deleting data does not affect other websites. Microphone audio is analysed in memory only after Start and permission. No recording, playback, audio history or upload; Stop releases tracks and the audio context. Camera requests video only after Start and permission; images are not recorded, read as pixels, stored or uploaded. Stop clears the video and releases tracks; device IDs and labels are not retained. Controllers are read only after Start; IDs, buttons, axes and drift statistics remain in the session, without storage, upload or vibration.
notFoundText: This address does not exist or the tool has not been published.
errorText: An error occurred while loading. Try again or return to the tool list.
consentVisual: Color patterns can be bright. Adjust display brightness before viewing.

deviceTools.deviceLimit: Browser information may be rounded, reduced or unavailable. It does not identify a CPU model, installed RAM or native panel resolution. Nothing is uploaded or saved automatically.
deviceTools.compatibilityLimit: API availability does not prove permission, attached hardware or successful operation. This scan never requests media or permission and never creates an AudioContext or WebGL context.
deviceTools.detailedRenderer: Opt in to detailed renderer information
deviceTools.gpuUnavailable: A WebGL context could not be read. It may be unavailable, blocked or lost; this does not diagnose a GPU fault.
deviceTools.gpuLimit: Strings may be masked, virtualized or describe software rendering. They do not confirm a physical GPU, VRAM or performance. Detailed driver data is read only after opt-in; the temporary context is released after reading.
deviceTools.storageConsent: Read data writes, reads and removes one isolated temporary key in localStorage and sessionStorage. It does not delete existing data or request persistent storage.
deviceTools.cleanupWarning: The browser blocked removal of a temporary probe key. Existing application data has not been deleted.
deviceTools.storageLimit: Usage and quota are rough origin estimates, not physical disk capacity or free disk space. Missing estimates remain unknown. IndexedDB and CacheStorage API exposure does not prove successful I/O.
deviceTools.pointerLimit: Start activates this region for up to 60 seconds. Pointer type, pressure and contact geometry are browser-reported and may be synthesized. They do not establish physical force or panel specifications.
deviceTools.pointerArea: Touch, pen and mouse observation region
deviceTools.pointerActive: Move a mouse, touch or use a pen here.
deviceTools.pointerIdle: Select Start to activate this region.
deviceTools.taskInterrupted: The task stopped because focus, visibility or viewport changed. Start again for a new session.
deviceTools.movementLimit: Move a mouse inside the region after Start. Values use CSS pixels, not DPI/CPI, physical distance or sensor latency. Average speed includes idle time. Only the last 120 trail points are retained; sessions stop after 60 seconds.
deviceTools.movementActive: Move your mouse here; leaving breaks the path.
deviceTools.accuracyLimit: Use the primary mouse button to hit 10 targets. Misses keep the target in place. This is a user pointing task, not sensor precision or hardware latency. Tasks stop at 60 seconds or 1,000 attempts.
deviceTools.mouseRequired: Use the primary mouse button for scored attempts. Keyboard, touch and pen input are not scored.
deviceTools.fullscreenLimit: Fullscreen requires a user action and browser support. Use the inline region if unavailable. Rendered dimensions are CSS pixels, not native panel resolution.
deviceTools.fullscreenError: Fullscreen was refused or interrupted. Use the inline region or try again from its button.
deviceTools.exitHint: Use the exit button or Esc. Your browser may provide another exit gesture.

audioTools.consent: Lower system volume first. Start plays a signal for up to 10 seconds. Begin at a low level; stop if uncomfortable. Focus loss or leaving this tab stops playback.
audioTools.range: 20–20,000 Hz, below the actual context Nyquist frequency. Levels describe digital amplitude, not acoustic loudness.
audioTools.invalid: Enter a valid frequency within the supported range. Playback is stopped for invalid settings.
audioTools.blocked: Playback was not allowed or did not start. Check browser audio settings, then select Start again.
audioTools.failed: The audio session could not run. Check the output device and browser settings, then try again.
audioTools.interrupted: Playback stopped because focus, visibility or audio context state changed. Select Start to play again.
audioTools.interpretation: Playing signal means the Web Audio graph is active. Completed means the signal ended. Neither confirms audible output or working hardware. No microphone, recording, upload or saved history.

inputAudio.consent: Start requests microphone access and processes live audio on this device for up to 60 seconds. No speaker monitoring, recording, history or upload. Stop releases the stream; leaving this tab also stops it.
inputAudio.latePrompt: The browser permission request is still pending. Stop cannot dismiss its prompt. Any late stream will be released; wait for the request to settle before starting again.
inputAudio.muted: The browser reports a muted input track. Live readings are cleared until it becomes unmuted.
inputAudio.spectrumDescription: 64 logarithmic bands from the current microphone FFT window. The strongest bin is also provided as text.
inputAudio.waveformDescription: 64 samples decimated from the current digital input window; RMS and peak are available as text.
inputAudio.noData: No live samples. Start and allow microphone access to display data.
inputAudio.frequencyAxis: Log frequency axis: 20 Hz → {max} Hz. Vertical range: −100 to −10 dBFS. Empty FFT bands remain empty.
inputAudio.waveformNote: Current 2048-sample window, decimated to 64 display points. The graphic is clipped to ±1; numeric peaks retain their actual value.
inputAudio.interpretation: Digital levels are not dB SPL or calibrated microphone quality. Silence does not prove a fault. Browser/OS processing can change the stream. Stop and Reset clear the readings; audio never enters saved history.
inputAudio.audio-unavailable: Web Audio is unavailable. Use a browser exposing AudioContext; no microphone has been opened.
inputAudio.audio-blocked: The audio context could not run. The session was stopped. Check browser audio settings and select Start again after any permission request settles.
inputAudio.analysis-failed: Audio analysis failed and all session resources were released. Check browser/device settings and try again.
inputAudio.interrupted: The session stopped after focus, page visibility or audio context state changed. Select Start to try again.
inputAudio.input-ended: The input stream ended or device access was revoked. The session has stopped.
inputAudio.timeout: The 60-second session limit was reached. Resources were released; a pending browser prompt may still remain.

cameraTools.consent: Start requests camera access for up to 60 seconds. Local preview only; no microphone, recording, history or upload. Stop or leaving this tab releases the camera.
cameraTools.latePrompt: The browser permission request is still pending. Stop cannot dismiss its prompt. Any late stream will be released; wait for the request to settle before starting again.
cameraTools.noData: No video. Select Start and allow camera access to preview.
cameraTools.muted: The browser reports a muted camera track. FPS readings are cleared until valid frames return.
cameraTools.fpsUnavailable: This browser does not expose requestVideoFrameCallback. FPS cannot be measured; video and stream settings remain available when supported.
cameraTools.fpsMethod: Observed FPS = change in presentedFrames / callback time, over at least 2 seconds. Insufficient samples or no new frame for over 2 seconds: —.
cameraTools.interpretation: Reported resolution/FPS describe the current stream settings. Observed FPS describes compositor submissions and may be limited by display refresh rate or system load; it does not certify sensor specifications or hardware FPS. Stop/Reset clears all readings.
cameraTools.playback-blocked: Video could not play within 10 seconds. The camera was released. Check browser settings and select Start again.
cameraTools.camera-ended: The camera stream ended or access was revoked. The session has stopped.
cameraTools.interrupted: The session stopped after focus loss, a hidden page or paused video. Select Start to try again.
cameraTools.timeout: The 60-second session limit was reached. Resources were released; a browser permission prompt may still remain.
cameraTools.preview-failed: Video could not be read or displayed. The session stopped and released the camera.

gamepadTools.consent: Start reads the Gamepad API locally for up to 120 seconds. No microphone/camera request, vibration, stored IDs/logs/history or upload. Stop, leaving the tab or focus loss clears data and polling.
gamepadTools.connect: Connect a controller and press a controller button while this page has focus. The browser may not expose it until interaction; an empty list does not prove a faulty controller.
gamepadTools.truncated: Display is bounded to 16 slots, 64 axes, 128 buttons and 120 trail points to keep memory bounded.
gamepadTools.standard: Standard mapping: axes 0/1 default to the left stick; 2/3 can be selected for the right stick. Positive Y is down. Physical labels may differ between controllers.
gamepadTools.unmapped: Left/right stick suggestions apply only to standard mapping. For other mappings, select two different axes; the controller layout is not inferred.
gamepadTools.plotDescription: Normalized axis plot from minus one to one, with positive Y down; X/Y values are also provided as text.
gamepadTools.plotNote: The point and trail use raw values. The reference circle does not change device deadzones, subtract offsets or renormalize coordinates.
gamepadTools.neutral: Select Measure rest position, then release the stick. Allow 1 second to settle, followed by 5 seconds of observations. Do not move the controller or touch the stick during this window.
gamepadTools.driftLimits: These summarize browser data, not a hardware drift diagnosis. Polls may repeat the same data. OS/browser deadzones, drivers and calibration affect results; corner radius can reach √2. A zero reading does not prove a perfect sensor.
gamepadTools.interpretation: Data describes the current Gamepad API only. It does not measure USB polling rate/latency or automatically judge a controller good or faulty. Stop/Reset clears readings and drift results; Start again after interruption.

capability.available: Gamepad API available; the browser must still expose the device.
capability.unsupported: This runtime does not provide the required Gamepad API and requestAnimationFrame. No hardware result is available.
capability.insecure-context: HTTPS or a trustworthy localhost is required.
capability.policy-blocked: Document policy blocks the Gamepad API. No controller is read.

failure.interaction-required: Focus this visible page and select Start directly.
failure.blocked: The browser or document policy refused Gamepad API access. The session stopped; this is not a controller fault diagnosis.
failure.read-failed: Controller data could not be read. Polling stopped and data was cleared; check browser/driver settings and retry.
failure.disconnected: The selected controller is no longer exposed or has disconnected. The session stopped without switching devices automatically.
failure.device-changed: The device, mapping or axis/button structure at this slot changed. The session stopped to avoid mixing data.
failure.interrupted: The session stopped after focus loss, a hidden page or navigation. Select Start to continue.
failure.timeout: The 120-second limit was reached. The session stopped and cleared data.

driftPhase.settling: Allowing 1 second to settle; release the stick.
driftPhase.completed: Window complete; read the results before Stop or Reset.
driftPhase.invalid: Insufficient continuous valid data. Results were cleared; try again with this page focused.

problems.title: What is happening with your device?
problems.description: Choose the symptom you notice to find a useful test.
problems.note: These tools help you observe symptoms; they do not automatically diagnose a faulty device. You control when to activate each test on its tool page.

screen.title: Screen feels choppy
screen.description: Sample browser frame timing and look for motion ghosting.

keyboard.title: Keys keep repeating
keyboard.description: Watch for unexpected repeated presses and check how each key responds.

microphone.title: Microphone is not working
microphone.description: Check the input signal after granting microphone access, then explore its audio spectrum.

keyboardTools.layoutProgress: Received {tested}/{total} key codes in this layout
keyboardTools.layoutNote: Progress uses received events and is retained when switching layouts. This diagram is a reference; an unreceived key is not necessarily faulty.
keyboardTools.outsideLayout: Received codes outside the selected diagram
keyboardTools.localNote: Keys are captured only in the activated test area; data stays in tab memory, without upload or automatic storage.
keyboardTools.unidentified: {count} events had no code. They remain in the log but do not count toward coverage, rollover or chatter.
keyboardTools.composing: {count} events belonged to IME/composition. They are excluded from physical-key statistics; inspect isComposing in the log.
keyboardTools.codeLimit: This session reached 256 key codes; new codes appear only in the log. Reset to begin a new session.
keyboardTools.rolloverNote: Keeps the first combination that reached the session maximum. This does not certify NKRO/6KRO; the browser/OS may intercept keys.
keyboardTools.flagsNote: Browser-reported flags do not establish LED state or a hardware source. isTrusted does not certify physical input.
keyboardTools.chatterNote: Totals accumulate until Reset, with auto-repeat separate. Integer thresholds: 1–500 ms. Pairs do not span focus loss, layout changes or IME. A short gap does not establish a faulty switch.
keyboardTools.logWindow: Keeping {retained}/200 recent events; {total} events received. Clearing the log keeps statistics.
keyboardTools.diagramHint: The diagram scrolls horizontally. Tab/Esc ends capture; when inactive, focus the diagram and use arrow keys to scroll. Test with real keys; tapping a keycap does not generate a result.
